note: YHWH is spelled out here as "JEHOVAH", a hybrid of the consonants YHWH with the vowels of Adonai; elsewhere the KJV writes LORD. The name was most likely pronounced Yahweh. Context: known in the character the name expresses (medium confidence). 6:6-7 'you shall know that I am Yahweh' when I redeem you: 'know' means experience the name's meaning through the exodus, not first hear the word.
